premades.name: Agna Holt
premades.about: A Cyrel soldier who walked away from Bastion after the night her company was left outside the gate. Deserters hang, so she calls herself a logger now and keeps her sword wrapped in sacking under the bunk. Good in a fight, bad at being told what to do, worse at sleeping.

premades.name: Lirien of the Ford
premades.about: Half-elf, born at Low Ford to a mother who never named the father. Too human for Brynwyr, too elven for Kingswood, so they run whatever needs carrying across the stones at night: salt one way, herbs and worse the other. They know the warden paths and owe the wrong people on both sides.

premades.name: Tobin Pell
premades.about: Tally clerk for the Timber Guild and the storekeeper's useless son. He has skimmed a board in twenty for four years and the factor has started counting behind him. Clever, soft-handed, charming when frightened, and lately very frightened.
